training: Only general39 train affine/compaction/scan cells at32 and16384; both emitter versions permitted and separately tagged. No heldout frames or regressions selected as fit data.
heldout: All2048 cells from train families and whole branch/ordered/stencil/overwrite families. No coefficients, feature choices or selection thresholds retuned after their observation.
fit: Deterministic nonnegative coordinate least squares on relative prediction residuals; column scale from training only;1200 fixed sweeps or1e-10 maximum scaled coefficient delta. Zero-feature columns retained as unidentified; rank/support reported.
targets: Separate host/target/result-boundary models. Complete requests cannot be pooled with resident destinations or resident GPU input/full owned readback. Only actual GPU calls enter GPU fit.
limits: Source component estimates are untrusted hypotheses; lowering may differ. No cost profile changes theorem admission. Low rank and unseen feature support reported; poor heldout models remain opt-in.
selection: Minimum estimated cost among already proven eligible alternatives, minimum10% saving versus baseline. Freeze all coefficients and predictions before inspecting heldout evaluation.
evaluation: Absolute/relative prediction error by split and family; choice regret against measured comparable alternatives; all losses/inconclusive cells retained; no pooled language-wide superiority claim.
